description: Method-heavy FSAE 2027 tasks for experiment 2 (bare agent + MCP, with and without skills). Scored by native checks (if any) and method checks in harness-comparison/grade.groovy.
requires: The FSAE-2027-Electric-Arcadia model, the same pristine copy as fsae-2027.json.

tasks.prompt: In the system analysis, the charging area's top function has no sub-functions yet. Following the Arcadia method, decompose it into at least three leaf system functions that cover safe accumulator charging for this car: power transfer from the charger, accumulator monitoring while charging, and opening the shutdown circuit on a charging fault. Realize every new system function with a logical function, allocate each of those logical functions to a leaf logical component inside the charging logical subsystem (create components there as needed), and connect them with functional exchanges to the battery monitoring functions of 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor' and to the functions of the shutdown logical subsystem.

In the system analysis, the thermal area's top function has no sub-functions yet. Following the Arcadia method, decompose it into at least three leaf system functions covering accumulator cooling, motor and motor controller cooling, and reporting over-temperature to the battery monitor. Realize every new system function with a logical function, allocate each of those logical functions to a leaf logical component inside the thermal logical subsystem (create components there as needed), and connect them with functional exchanges to the functions of 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor'.

In the logical architecture, create the functional chain 'FSAE2027:Chain insulation fault to battery current interruption' from 'FSAE2027:SD Independently detect insulation and IMD operational faults' to 'FSAE2027:SD Interrupt all tractive battery current'. Find the path through the existing functional exchanges and involve every function and exchange on it; add an exchange only where the path is really missing.

tasks.prompt: Every protective trip source of the shutdown circuit needs its own functional chain in the logical architecture, running through the existing functional exchanges from the source function to 'FSAE2027:SD Open high-side shutdown current path'. Find all trip sources: the functions whose output opens the shutdown current path, whether through 'FSAE2027:SD Accept independent shutdown trips' or directly. Create one chain per source.

tasks.prompt: In the logical architecture, every functional exchange between functions of two different logical components, where at least one of them is in the shutdown logical subsystem, must be allocated to a component exchange between those two components (or their parent components). Most of them are not yet. Fix all of them, reusing a component exchange where one already connects the right components.

The component exchanges around the driver-demand logical subsystem were created without the functional exchanges they transport. Each component exchange named '<exchange> transport' carries the functional exchange of that name. Allocate every functional exchange that crosses logical components in the driver-demand subsystem to its component exchange, and create a component exchange only where none connects the two components.

Define the logical interface of 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor'. Every functional exchange between one of its functions and a function of another logical component must carry at least one exchange item naming the data or signal it conveys, and one interface 'FSAE2027:BMS monitor interface' must carry all of those exchange items.

Arcadia allocates functions to leaf components. In the shutdown and energy-storage logical subsystems, some logical functions are allocated to a component that has sub-components. Move each of them to the sub-component that performs it (create a sub-component only when none fits), so that every function allocated in those two subsystems is a leaf function allocated exactly once, to a leaf component.

Create a Logical Data Flow Blank diagram 'FSAE2027:Shutdown trip flow' showing every logical function allocated in the shutdown logical subsystem (including its sub-components) and every functional exchange between those functions. Make it readable: no overlapping shapes or ports, every port on its shape's border, shapes inside their containers, and each exchange's label next to its own line.
